3) Quickstart timeline: senior engs want to know how long until we can push a small test into staging and what telemetry you provide out of the box for token/cost visibility.

Can you send a short recap and proposed next steps (owners + timing)? We're aiming to decide by next Friday.

Samir — thanks for the notes. Quick recap below and a recommended lightweight onramp plan. Attaching a short playbook and an endpoint mapping matrix.

Summary of Hosted guarantees (short):
- Logical isolation: sandbox keys create tenant-scoped endpoints; data from sandbox endpoints is not persisted to shared production caches.
- Data residency: Hosted regions can be pinned by account (us-east, us-west, eu-central). Production pinning available for customers with residency needs.
- Escalation path: if you need guaranteed single-tenant GPUs or stricter network isolation we recommend Redwood Dedicated; for air-gapped regulatory needs we offer a Private control plane deployment.

When to move off Hosted:
- Sustained peak throughput that violates hosted SLA (predictable >40 RPS sustained per org) OR
- Contractual/regulatory need for dedicated hardware or air-gapped control plane OR
- Need for in-stack KMS/HSM integrations not supported on hosted plan.

Endpoint mapping & rate shaping recommendation:
- Map three logical endpoints for your pilot: search-embeds (embedding endpoint), prompt-complete (stateless generate endpoint), and conv-stream (chat/streaming endpoint for UX).
- Use a token budget per endpoint and prefix/KV cache for the conv-stream to reduce repeated context costs. We recommend: baseline 2 RPS per endpoint with burst window rules up to 25 RPS for 2-minute windows for the first 6 weeks.
- Configure client-side exponential backoff + server-side graceful throttling (429 with Retry-After) so short bursts are absorbed.

Quickstart & telemetry:
- Staging test: we can provision sandbox endpoints in 48–72 hours after you accept the playbook and share the initial API keys.
- Observability: Console gives per-endpoint token usage, per-request latency histogram, and cost-per-token breakdown. We can share a 14-day telemetry export for your spike tests.

Proposed next steps (owners & timing):
- Today: I'll share the playbook + endpoint matrix (attached). Owner: Ava (attached).
- Tue 09/19: internal infra review with NovaPay (30–45m). Owner: Samir + James.
- Wed 09/20: Sandbox endpoints provisioned by Redwood. Owner: Ben.
- Thu 09/21: First smoke test + telemetry collection window. Owner: James.
- Fri 09/22: Decision checkpoint to continue on Hosted or open Dedicated evaluation. Owner: Samir.

If you want, we can include a short cost estimate for the pilot (token + burst credit). Ben, can you add the pilot cost stub to the playbook before I send?

Thanks — attaching: EcomLytics-hosted-onramp-playbook.pdf, endpoint-matrix.xlsx

Best,
Ava Chen
